fusions.name: Quick Jab
fusions.desc: A snap blow that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Spooked Stampede
fusions.desc: Bolts through enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 13 damage and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Burst Start
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Building Speed
fusions.desc: When you have run a good distance, your damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
